displayPattern: 7-segment display on a Trane S9V2 two-stage variable-speed furnace (Service Facts S9V2-SF-2A-EN): E15
meaning: Personality module and control data are both corrupted.
diySteps: Write down E15. The troubleshooting step shown for fault 15 is to disconnect power
Technician: the chart's possible causes are a corrupted personality module and a faulty IFC. It does not list a filter or a gas-valve check
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician. E15 is corrupted unit data on both the personality module and the control.
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
sourceTitle: Trane S9V2 Service Facts S9V2-SF-2A-EN (04 Mar 2021), troubleshooting section. Read 2026-11-07
